decision.instructions: Choose whether the coordinator should intervene now.

criteria.WAKE: Wake when timely coordination can help: e.g. a worker sent a peer_message to coordinator, hit NO_PROGRESS_FAILING, HUNK_CHURN, PEER_OVERLAP, or SUBMIT_REJECTED, or recent steps show repeated errors or stagnation.
criteria.SKIP: Skip when the worker can reasonably continue without an intervention.
